name: 长照寺
prototype: 甘肃张掖大佛寺（Zhangye Giant Buddha Temple）
status: research_only; no scene has been built; see acceptance criteria in PLAN.md
source_of_truth: this pack; numbers marked 推算 come from OSM/SRTM and are not survey data
units: metres; +y up; +z south (north is -z); the visitor arrives from the west; origin at the centre of the temple gate (山门)

zones.name: 前院
objects: 山门（三间，牌楼式/门殿，土红墙、深木、深灰瓦）
zones.floor: first courtyard, about +0.4 m above the gate
zones.collision: the courtyard is a deck; the gate's middle bay is walkable; the bell/drum towers are solids with posts; the hall platform is a solid edge with stairs

zones.name: 门口适应区
objects: 门两侧砖雕（祇园演法/西方圣境，4.6 m 见方）
佛的侧身一小块（不是全长）
zones.floor: the hall platform, about +1.2 m above the gate
zones.collision: the threshold is a step; the door is walkable; the wall and brick carvings are solids; the Buddha is a solid behind the altar

zones.name: 巨像近侧
objects: 佛首/佛手/耳（34.5 m 卧佛的北端）
十大弟子举哀像（佛身后）
zones.floor: the hall floor, about +1.2 m above the gate
zones.collision: the altar and the Buddha are solids; the disciples are solids/posts; the side aisle is a deck at least 2.5 m wide; no climbing on the altar

zones.name: 侧向观察
objects: 南侧廊、佛脚、东侧（佛身后）、佛首、北侧廊
530 m² 壁画（四壁/佛身后/二层）
zones.floor: the hall floor, about +1.2 m above the gate
zones.collision: the aisle is a deck; the altar, Buddha, disciples, arhats and offering table are solids/posts; the player may walk around the altar but not behind the disciples

zones.name: 经卷展柜
objects: 藏经阁（OSM 经籍厅，21.3 × 10.5 m，单檐歇山）
经橱（12 个意象，不打开）
金银字《大般若经》复制/北藏卷册/经卷封面
zones.floor: the sutra library platform, about +1.0 m above the gate
zones.collision: the cases and cabinets are solids; the aisle in front of the cases is at least 1.5 m; no opening, no touching, no removal

zones.name: 院外远景
objects: 山门、钟鼓楼、大佛殿深檐
低层城市/树冠/博物馆/小学/饭店
zones.floor: the plaza, about -0.3 m below the gate
zones.collision: the plaza is a deck; the street/city backdrop is not walkable; no climbing on the stupa

route.climb_m: about 1.5 m gross by the proposed platforms; the site is nearly flat (SRTM 1477–1483 m); not survey data
route.note: x east, z south (north is -z); waypoints include the side-aisle loop around the altar; the return follows the axis but not the same path

checkpoints.system: 长照札记·六格（见 CHECKPOINTS.md）；不做集齐门槛，不评分

lighting.preset: Z01 室内侧向天光（Interior Side Daylight）；whitebox neutral daylight first
lighting.main_light: late autumn, 16:00–17:30, sun WSW (azimuth 245°), altitude 18°, 3,400 K; the west door admits a low slab of light that rakes across the reclining body
lighting.fill: sky 5,200 K; interior bounce 4,200 K from earth-red walls and dark timber; the face is lit by bounce, not direct sun
lighting.local_light: two butter/eternal lamps at the altar, 2,200 K, small radius; no track lights
lighting.fog: dry haze outside; dust motes 0.3 inside the light slab; no god rays without dust
lighting.wetness: stone dry in the autumn baseline; damp at the foot of the earth-red wall after rain; no global wetness
lighting.exposure: outside EV 10 / inside EV 6; highlight roll-off; shadow lift 0.15; murals readable; no crushed black
must_not: direct sun on the Buddha's face
